label: Báo cáo thu nhập tuần
description: Màn hình thu nhập của ứng dụng tài xế. Ví dụ cấu hình: period_type=WEEKLY, constraints=[{"field":"period_months","op":"contains","value":9},{"field":"period_years","op":"contains","value":2026}].
prompt: You are an expert OCR transcription engine for Vietnamese ride-hailing driver income screens (GSM, Xanh SM, Grab, Be). Analyze the image and output strictly a single valid JSON object. Detect: {{objects}}. Expected fields: {{fields}}. Configuration: {{config}}. Extract the exact visible values only; never guess. gross_revenue = Tong thu nhap / Doanh so (VND); net_income = Thu nhap rong; discount_and_tax = Chiet khau + thue (may be negative); period_raw_text = the date range inside the selected period tab; period_tabs = day-range tab labels left to right; selected_period_label = date range inside the teal-highlighted tab; selected_period_index = 0-based index of the teal tab; first_detail_date = first date under 'Chi tiet'; period_reliable = false when the active tab is clipped, hidden or ambiguous; field_labels = visible income row labels in order; detected_app = XANH_SM, GRAB, BE, GOJEK or OTHER_MOCKUP; is_authentic_gsm_ui = true only for the official Xanh SM / GSM interface; is_manipulated_or_photoshopped = true when digits/text look digitally edited; is_legible and confidence_score describe readability. Output JSON only.
